fact: Tech Africa News reports Gabon is developing an interoperability platform meant to let government information systems securely exchange data, reviewed at the sixth e-Gabon-SIS and Gabon Digital steering committee; no live connections or figures are given.

The World Bank's Digital Gabon ISR (Dec 2024) sets a closing-2026 target of 5 government entities exchanging data on the government interoperability platform, with the actual at baseline 0, and the loan only 1.92% disbursed.
